peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (35.2): 2.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 139 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Initial resale-wave effect: 2 of the 2 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–May 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 610 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 1,050 m; closer than 106 of 551 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 790 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 850 m), more than 121 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48); nearest hawker centre Redhill Market about 790 m; nearest park Camp Road Interim Park about 780 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,010 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,070 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,270 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,310 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,660 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,690 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,780 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,850 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 182 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,715 new sales and 913 resales (2,628 purchases); new sales were 65.3% of these purchases. Subsales (8) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 913 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,045 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.6%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
